Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HiddenZombieFix_t: Draws zombies that stand in plain view but are left undrawn, and lets them see you too. Needs PZ Tools. Does nothing while the Zombie Visibility Fix mod is on. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_Monologue_tooltip: The character says a short line over their head at moments such as a cure, a test or reaching a mission's place. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CreditMultiplier_: Multiplies the credits every delivery earns.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_TrustThresholdMul: Multiplies the trust each stage and milestone needs. Lower means faster progress.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BonusMultiplier_t: Multiplies the bonus credits for codex goals, first-time shredding of an item kind, fully searched buildings and kill milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_RequestPrice_tool: Percent of the fixed unit price paid for this week's requested items. 100 is the standard (600 / 1,500 / 4,000 a unit); the request price upgrades multiply on top of it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterArrival: Fewest hours from a call to the helicopter's arrival, at the start. Shortens as trust rises.
Most hours from a call to the helicopter's arrival, at the start. Shortens as trust rises.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CallInterval_tool: Days after a helicopter call before you can call again. Shortens as trust rises.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_HelicopterNoiseRa: How many tiles away zombies hear the drop helicopter. At 0 zombies do not hear it.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_BoxReissueCost_to: Credits for a new delivery box. A short balance becomes debt.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionDeadline_t: Days you get to seal a mission's item into a delivery box.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionInterval_t: Days after a mission ends or expires until the next one comes.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShopPriceMultipli: Multiplies shop prices, except upgrade serums and delivery box reissues.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_KitsForSale_toolt: Bag capacity, bag weight, trunk and engine kits reach the shop at the first milestone. Default: on.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumPrice_to: Base price of one cure serum, in credits.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_CureSerumShelfLif: Days from receipt until a cure serum no longer works.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumPrice: Credits for a tree's first upgrade serum.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeSerumGrowt: Each upgrade serum of a tree costs this many times the one before. From the 27th on, the price rises by a fixed amount.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_UpgradeEffectMult: Multiplies research effects that have a number.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_SharedSerumMilest: After the top stage, a shared enhancement serum comes every this many trust milestones.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_ShredDecay_toolti: How many recent shreds of one kind halve its yield. Lower makes repeats yield less sooner.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MeteorSites_toolt: Multiplies the number of meteor drop sites. At 1 there are 24.
Sandbox_OperationAcorn_MissionGuards_too: When you first come near a mission's building, 2 to 4 more zombies are inside it, dressed for the place, such as police at a police station. Default: on.
